name: Omathor for THORChain
author: sette7blo
description: THORChain at a glance: network health, the churn, your bonded nodes, THORNames, node votes and pools, from public THORNode and Midgard APIs. Read-only. Bonds are found locally; an address is sent only once, to find its THORNames.

barWidget.description: A bolt coloured by THORChain's health and your bonded nodes, with a panel for the network, bonds, THORNames, votes, pools and chains.
